description: combraintf 统筹已登记的独立方法和可复用流程。支持：COMBRAINTF 原项目训练脚本。

method_refs.label: COMBRAINTF 原项目训练脚本
method_refs.role: Run the original combraintf trainer on per-subject FC tensor dictionaries in <atlas>/sub-*.pt and matching CSV labels. The adapter validates subject IDs, square finite matrices, ROI consistency and fold sizes, and redirects checkpoints and logs into this run。 Inputs: fmri_root: 原始 FC 数据根目录（内含 atlas/sub-*.pt） (directory); labels_csv: 完整样本标签 CSV (file). Registered outputs: results/training.log, results/execution.json. Fixed invocation options: --model combraintf.

name: combraintf
